subject: expression: remove direct dependencies with `sessionctx.Context` for package `expression` (#51025)
summary: Refactors `pkg/expression` (and `pkg/expression/aggregation`) APIs to depend on `expression.BuildContext`/`expression.EvalContext` (plus new `variable.SessionVarsProvider`) instead of `sessionctx.Context`; updates planner window-function TiFlash pushdown checks to pass `kv.Client` explicitly; adds `SessionVarsProvider` interface in `pkg/sessionctx/variable` to support param-marker handling without full `sessionctx.Context` dependency.
